title: 第13章 这就是符篆师第14章 他们怎么也来了
lines: 第13章这就是符篆师
穆锡跟着万雄的团队，从另一个入口，进入了百城的城际副本。
城际副本每周刷新一次，分高中和大学两个地图。
百城也是有大学的，而且不止一所，只不过等级和师资力量没办法跟那些名校相提并论。
但学生的人数加起来，也有几十万之多！
高中地图每次刷新，宝箱几乎都是一中的。
准确的说，只要万雄参加，宝箱的归属就毫无悬念。
万雄的家境虽然跟姬彩衣比不了，但也不算差，并不是个缺钱的人，大多数时候的副本刷新他都不会参与。
这次因为有穆锡加入团队，他需要在短时间内，让穆锡彻底融入进来，成为团队的一份子。
所以才决定带他进来见识一下。
而穆锡，也希望通过这一次，让万雄看见他的实力！
他可不是进来参观学习的，他要在这里证明自己。
万雄的团队，原本三男一女，万雄是团长，主攻。
另外两个男生一个叫李秋风，又瘦又高，武器是一杆长枪，六级灵战士；另一个叫潘相文，中等身材，武器是飞刀，算是中短程攻击，同样也是六级。
唯一的女生，是个瓜子脸的黑长直漂亮妹子，两条大长腿，皮肤特别白嫩。
名叫司空菲云，也是六级灵战士。
她的武器有些特殊，是链子锤！
一条足有十几米长的合金链子，两边连着两个直径十二三厘米，极为沉重的圆形锤头。
这东西一旦舞起来，根本没人能近她的身。
不看武器的话，司空菲云妥妥是个女神，看到她的武器，十个男人里面大概会有九个被吓跑。
这玩意如果砸在脑袋上，一下就死。
如今加上穆锡这个攻击型的符篆师，万雄的这支团队，可以说是一支暴力输出的团队。
“菲云一会顶在最前面，我在左，秋风在右，相文和穆锡殿后。”万雄说着，看了一眼穆锡：“一定要注意安全，虽然痛感只有百分之十，但如果不小心被杀……”
司空菲云笑着在一旁说道：“那滋味最好还是不要尝试。”
穆锡点点头：“我明白，谢谢师兄师姐们。”
应该在谁面前乖巧，他还是懂的。
毕竟接下来这一年，他需要通过这个团队来实现很多目标。
“走吧！”万雄看了一眼没有回应的个人智脑，轻轻叹了口气。
司空菲云在他身边轻声道：“雄哥，她还小，只要你坚持……”
万雄摇摇头，苦笑道：“唉，不管我多优秀，她如果不喜欢我，我都没机会的。”
司空菲云看着万雄欲言又止，最终还是什么都没说。而是将合金链子抓在手中，若有所思的旋转着两个沉重的锤头。
然后一马当先走在前面。
这边刘志远和白牧野等人，也进入了城际副本。
沿着一条宽阔街道边缘，小心翼翼向前推进。
这种地方可不敢浪，虽然没死过，但听说死一次的滋味相当难受！
高中级别的城际副本，一般不会出现等级太高的生物。
五级小恶魔之类，差不多就算是强大的了。
content_en:
Chapter 13 This is the Talisman Seal Master
Mu Xi followed Wan Xiong's team and entered the intercity dungeon of Hundred Cities from another entrance.
The intercity dungeon is refreshed once a week and is divided into two maps: high school and college.
There are also universities in Hundred Cities, and there are more than one, but the level and faculty are not comparable to those of famous schools.
But the total number of students is hundreds of thousands!
Every time the high school map is refreshed, the treasure chests are almost always the same.
To be precise, as long as Wan Xiong participates, there will be no suspense about the ownership of the treasure box.
Although Wan Xiong's family background is not comparable to that of Ji Caiyi, it is not bad. He is not a person who is short of money. Most of the time, he will not participate in the dungeon refresh.
This time, because Mu Xi joined the team, he needed to fully integrate Mu Xi into the team in a short period of time and become a part of the team.
That's why I decided to bring him in to see him.
And Mu Xi also hopes that through this time, Wan Xiong can see his strength!
He didn't come here to visit and learn, he wanted to prove himself here.
Wan Xiong's team originally consisted of three men and one woman, with Wan Xiong as the leader and the main attacker.
The other two boys were named Li Qiufeng, who was thin and tall. His weapon was a spear and was a level six spiritual warrior. The other was named Pan Xiangwen, who was of medium build and whose weapon was a flying knife. It was a medium- and short-range attack and was also level six.
The only girl is a pretty girl with a melon-shaped face, long black hair, long legs, and extremely white and tender skin.
His name is Sikong Feiyun, and he is also a sixth-level spiritual warrior.
Her weapon is somewhat special, it's a chain hammer!
An alloy chain that is more than ten meters long is connected to two extremely heavy round hammer heads with a diameter of 12 or 13 centimeters on both sides.
Once this thing starts dancing, no one can get close to her.
If you don't look at the weapons, Sikong Feiyun is definitely a goddess. Seeing her weapons, probably nine out of ten men will be scared away.
If this thing hits your head, it will kill you instantly.
Now with the addition of Mu Xi, an offensive talisman master, Wan Xiong's team can be said to be a violent output team.
"Fei Yun is at the front, I am on the left, Qiu Feng is on the right, Xiang Wen and Mu Xi are in the rear." Wan Xiong said and glanced at Mu Xi: "You must pay attention to safety. Although the pain is only 10%, if you are accidentally killed..."
Sikong Feiyun smiled and said: "It's best not to try that taste."
Mu Xi nodded: "I understand, thank you, brothers and sisters."
He still understands who should be nice in front of someone.
After all, he needs to achieve many goals through this team in the coming year.
"Let's go!" Wan Xiong glanced at Zhi Nao, who didn't respond, and sighed softly.
Sikong Feiyun whispered beside him: "Brother Xiong, she is still young, as long as you persist..."
Wan Xiong shook his head and smiled bitterly: "Well, no matter how good I am, if she doesn't like me, I won't stand a chance."
Sikong Feiyun looked at Wan Xiong and hesitated to speak, but finally said nothing. Instead, he held the alloy chain in his hand and rotated the two heavy hammer heads thoughtfully.
Then he took the lead and walked ahead.
Here Liu Zhiyuan, Bai Muye and others also entered the intercity dungeon.
Carefully move forward along the edge of a wide street.
Don't dare to wander around in a place like this. Although I have never died, I heard that dying once is quite uncomfortable!
In high school level inter-city dungeons, there will generally not be creatures of too high a level.
A level 5 little devil is almost considered powerful.
title_en: Chapter 13 This is the Talisman Seal Master Chapter 14 Why are they here too?
